what: The card drops in folded in three layers, at 22px down and −3°, and settles with a bounce (.6s linear() bounce). The middle layer unfolds after .24s and the top layer after .6s, on a bottom hinge over .62s (−180° → −86° → 0 → −5° → 0, inner fold shade .14 → 0). The shadow spreads at .95s and the text lines write in from 6px below starting at 1.02s, .07s apart. On close (close child·Esc) the text erases in .16s, the top and middle layers fold back in reverse, then the card steps aside 8px left and 44px down, turning −4° — newsletter·notification card

options.speed: Length multiplier, default 1 (original) — .5 for frequently shown notices
options.exit: Value of data-exit when closing, default dismissed

note: Card background, border and shadow are --kf-bg, --kf-line and --kf-shadow-soft. Card position (fixed, bottom left, etc.) is set by the consumer css.

from.where: shared.css .postcard (Newsletter paper card — 6 seconds after boot finishes, bottom left)
